description: Free: the green/orange/red verdict only, for a transaction, token approval, EIP-712 signature or XRP Ledger transaction (type xrpl) your agent is about to sign. Limited to 10 calls per hour. For the reason codes and details use presign_check ($0.01); for a plain-language explanation presign_check_explain ($0.03).

amount.description: approval: amount in base units (0 = revoke)

chainId.description: EVM chain id, required for approval, transaction and signature: 1, 10, 56, 137, 8453, 42161 (8453 = Base)

origin.description: optional: the site asking for the signature or transaction (URL or hostname); a domain under 30 days old is orange

tx.description: xrpl: the unsigned transaction JSON (TransactionType, Account, Destination, Amount, …)

type.description: What the agent is about to sign; xrpl = an unsigned XRP Ledger transaction in tx

typedData.description: signature: the exact eth_signTypedData_v4 payload (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009 x402 payment, Seaport)

name: presign_quick_check

verdict.description: green: go ahead; orange: ask the user; red: do not sign or buy

title: Quick pre-sign verdict (free)
